said.text: It's crucial that we educate New Yorkers on their legal rights when engaging with federal immigration enforcement. Our city has a long history of strong sanctuary protections. However, our laws are only useful when people know about them and can use them. The NYC Know Your Rights Act, Int. 55-A, will empower New Yorkers and especially city workers by hanging up informational signage on city property.

did.text: Voted Yes on Int 0055-2026, requiring signage on city property describing certain constitutional and legal protections. Passed 44–6.

whyNote: Council Member Avilés sponsored Int 55-A; her statement in the Council's release the day of the vote describes the bill the vote passed, and she voted yes.
